materials.lid: Al 6061-T6, black anodized (emissivity ~0.85) except the masked contact faces (bare Al or conductive chromate conversion)
materials.plate: Al 5052 or 6061, 0.8 mm, bare (no anodize, no paint); no thermal paste on any contact face (posts, shoulders, rim)
materials.tray: ASA (or ABS / PC / PA12; heat deflection above 90 C; not PLA)
materials.gapfill: dispensed gap filler, low modulus, about 3 W/mK

masked.post_end: lid post end faces that bear on the PCB GND rings (H1-H4; the J6-corner post end face too, it bears on the plate area only via its shoulder)
masked.post_shoulder: post shoulders (5.5 mm) that clamp the plate
masked.lid_rim: lid rim face (z 14.6) that sits on the plate
masked.post_bore: M2 pilot bores (thread contact to the screw)

acceptance: lid to board GND (J5 USB-C shell) < 1 ohm, measured after assembly with a 4-wire or low-range ohmmeter
plate to board GND < 1 ohm, measured the same way

fan.fan: 30 x 30 mm 5 V axial fan, suction, on the duct top; powered from its own USB-A/USB-C 5 V supply, NOT from the board (board 5V budget unchanged)
fan.inlets: tray vents: 9 in the -x wall, 4 in the back wall (unchanged)
fan.mount: duct on the lid top with VHB tape; fan screwed to the duct (4 x M3 self-tapping, 24 mm pitch)
fan.material: duct printed in ASA / ABS / PC / PA12, as the tray
